title: [English (auto-generated)] Silicon Valley BANNED Americans from Buying Chinese EVs… Then Bought 3,00.srt
full_text: You are legally banned from buying this car, unless of course you are Google, because they just imported 3,200 of them. It's built by Zeekr, a Chinese automaker owned by Geely. Right now, Chinese EVs face a 127% tariff designed to keep them out of America completely. Waymo paid it anyway, 3,200 times. Here's what should actually bother you. It's not like it's hidden or a loophole, the ban only applies to cars sold to regular people. Waymo doesn't sell cars, it sells rides. So, the same government that says this car is too risky for your driveway is fine with you riding in the back of one. A US senator already called Waymo out over this in a hearing, and that didn't change anything. Each van costs Waymo over $100,000 once tariffs and sensors are added. Even with the massive tax penalty, a fully loaded Chinese EV platform is still cheaper and better built than anything Ford, GM, or Tesla can deliver. And they're doing it anyway, because it's still cheaper than the Jaguar they used to run. So, the next time someone tells you Chinese cars are banned for your safety, ask them why you're already riding in one. You just don't own it.
